chunks: Vanished has my power from me.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Hala 'anni sultaniyah' in Shia Islamic tradition?
ai.summary: This phrase, frequently cited in Shia hadith literature as a lament by the Prophet or the Imams, signifies the loss of political sovereignty (sultanah) and worldly authority. It highlights the transition from temporal rule to spiritual leadership, often interpreted as a reflection of divine decree regarding the diminishing of earthly power during the eras of the Imams.
